name: bigfish-ink-wash-photo
title_zh: 把照片重绘成留白写意水墨，保留主体与构图
tagline_zh: 拍糊了、背景杂、想换风格？它用几笔浓淡和大量留白重画照片，主体姿态、朝向、构图锚点都守住，像请了位水墨画师改稿。
tagline_en: Turn any photo into a spacious ink-wash painting—keeping the pose, direction, and composition anchors, while.
desc_en: Reimagine a user-supplied photograph as a spacious, spontaneous contemporary Chinese expressive ink painting made with few decisive strokes, large untouched paper, and only essential identifying anchors rather than precise reconstruction. Use for 写意水墨、水墨意境画、东方水墨、宣纸留白海报, photo-to-ink transformations, or revisions that must preserve a main subject, pose, direction, composition, or approved painted e
why_zh: 不是滤镜贴图，而是按写意逻辑重绘：先定主体锚点，再决定哪些细节可舍，落笔少而准，纸面留白是构图的一部分。
why_en: Not a filter—it re-draws with ink logic: locks subject anchors first, then decides what to discard, so strokes stay few and.
limit_zh: 只认照片输入，不认纯文字描述；只输出单张静态水墨图，不做动画或分镜；主体若在画面中占比过小或严重遮挡，锚点会漂移。
limit_en: Photo input only, no text-to-image. Single static output, no animation. Tiny or heavily occluded subjects may drift anchors—crop first.
